text: This report seeks an amendment to the by-law governing the Toronto Fire Department Superannuation and Benefit Fund (the Plan) to increase the Plan Committee Chair Honorarium amount from $7,500 to $15,000 per annum.

City Council on December 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend By-law 10649 governing the Toronto Fire Department Superannuation and Benefit Fund to increase the Plan Committee Chair Honorarium amount from $7,500 to $15,000 per annum.
